page_title: HEI 1-4 WER | Heidenheim v Werder Bremen 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

89' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) meets a nice cross deep inside the 18-yard box and produces a fine header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is well positioned and punches the ball away, deflecting it onto the post.
86' 1 - 4 Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
85' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Amos Pieper is replaced by Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen).
85' Here comes a substitution. Marvin Ducksch is given a rest as he is replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
83' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
83' The referee gives a yellow card to Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
83' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

80' 1 - 3 Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) finds his way to a cross from the corner kick and heads it in via a deflection off the top of the left post. There was absolutely nothing Michael Zetterer could do with it. The score changes to 1:3.
80' Heidenheim win a corner.
78' Here is a change. Mathias Honsak is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim).
75' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:6.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Jens Stage.
72' Substitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Marco Grull walks off.
72' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Felix Agu and he is replaced by Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen).
66' A yellow-coloured card is received by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim).
66' 0 - 3 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is teed up on the edge of the box by Mitchell Weiser, and his howitzer of a shot into the top right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:3.
62' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
61' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Michael Zetterer makes a simple save.
58' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
55' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
53' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
52' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
52' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Michael Zetterer to dive and make a save.

52' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Welz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Heidenheim win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
50' The ball is out of play. Heidenheim win a corner kick.
49' POST! Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
47' A wild pass somehow finds Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) comes on in place of Adrian Beck.
46' Half-time substitution. Benedikt Gimber is replaced by Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Niklas Dorsch is replaced by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jan Schoppner. He is replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Tobias Welz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

42' Great solo effort by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.

42' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) inside the box and he manages to steer it low to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Michael Zetterer makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
41' Heidenheim earn a corner.
41' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
40' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
39' What was Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
37' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' 0 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 0:2.
33' Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
31' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Werder Bremen out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
26' The ratio of the ball possession is 62:38.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Heidenheim.
18' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post.
18' The linesman points to the corner flag, Werder Bremen are going to take it.
17' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' Heidenheim quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kevin Muller to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
14' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
13' Referee Tobias Welz sees the trip by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Penalty awarded! Werder Bremen will take a penalty kick.

11' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Kevin Muller inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
9' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
6' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.
3' Heidenheim have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
2' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Tobias Welz was nominated as the referee for this game.
